messages:
nb_rep: Hey team, we (NorthBridge) are onboarding with BYOK across AWS & Azure. We use envelope encryption and need auditability for rewraps/key versions. Our questions: 1) exact minimum IAM/KMS key policy perms Redwood needs to generate data keys and perform rewrap, 2) cloud audit logging config to catch rewrap/Decrypt events, 3) key rotation constraints (we import keys) — docs unclear. Can you list steps? Thanks

devon_support: Thanks — tagging @maria_sse for security/RBAC, @tori_onboard for onboarding. What clouds/regions? Are keys imported or generated in each cloud? :eyes:

nb_rep: AWS CMKs (imported key material into KMS via ImportKeyMaterial) in us-east-1, and Azure Key Vault with imported HSM-protected key in a vault, East US 2. We want to avoid key material leaving our control. Also need CloudTrail-level audit for rewraps.

maria_sse: Short answer: we need specific crypto permissions + audit plumbing.

maria_sse: AWS checklist:
- Key policy must allow Redwood service principal to call: GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext, Decrypt, Encrypt, ReEncryptFrom
- If using imported key material, automatic KeyRotationEnabled is not available; document this to the customer
- Prefer granting specific AWS IAM Principal via a key policy statement or use grants for short-lived ops
- Ensure CloudTrail is configured to log Management events capturing KMS API calls (GenerateDataKey, ReEncrypt, Decrypt) and consider Data Events where appropriate

maria_sse: GCP checklist (if they add later): service account needs roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter and audit logs enabled for DATA_ACCESS

maria_sse: Azure Key Vault checklist:
- If using Key Vault (not Managed HSM) and RBAC model enabled, assign 'Key Vault Crypto Service Encryption User' (or the closest crypto role) to the Redwood service principal for the specific key
- Enable Key Vault diagnostic logs -> send 'AuditEvent' to Log Analytics/Event Hub/Storage so we can ingest rewrap/decrypt events
- Imported key material in Key Vault may affect rotation options; confirm whether they want periodic rewrap vs creating a new key version

maria_sse: Example minimal AWS key policy snippet for an IAM role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-svc
```
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {
      "Sid":"AllowRedwoodUse",
      "Effect":"Allow",
      "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-svc"},
      "Action":[
        "kms:Encrypt",
        "kms:Decrypt",
        "kms:GenerateDataKey",
        "kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext",
        "kms:ReEncrypt*"
      ],
      "Resource":"*"
    }
  ]
}
```

tori_onboard: Noted — docs gap: the onboarding guide currently shows a generic policy but doesn't call out GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext or ReEncrypt. I'll open a PR to add cloud-specific snippets and an Azure RBAC section. :thumbsup:

kms_bot: Automated check: CloudTrail config for account 123456789012 missing Management events for KMS. Key policy for alias/nb-cmk misses GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext. See https://console.aws.amazon.com/cloudtrail/home :warning:

jake_sec: Quick advice: if they import key material they can't use AWS automatic rotation for symmetric CMKs; recommend planning a rewrap workflow where a new key version is created and application-level data keys are re-encrypted (we can help with tooling). Also prefer using grants for temporary permissions rather than broad key policy statements.

nb_rep: Ok will confirm imported vs AWS-import. Also can you confirm the exact CloudTrail event names we should search for (we need to show compliance team)?

maria_sse: Search for: "ReEncrypt*", "GenerateDataKey*", "Decrypt" KMS API calls in CloudTrail. For CloudTrail eventName filter: ReEncrypt, GenerateDataKey, GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext, Decrypt. For Azure, look for 'Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/keys/decrypt/action' and 'wrapKey'/'unwrapKey' in diagnostic logs. For GCP, look for cloudkms.cryptoKeys.decrypt and cloudkms.cryptoKeys.encrypt in DATA_ACCESS logs.

tori_onboard: I'll update onboarding playbook and send a short checklist to NB with exact steps and sample policies. ETA EOD tomorrow. :calendar:

devon_support: Thanks everyone. NB, once you confirm import vs AWS-generated we'll run a short validation (we'll need an IAM role ARN and sample CloudTrail/diagnostic logs).

nb_rep: Thanks all — I'll get the ARN and sample CloudTrail and upload to the support ticket. Appreciate the fast triage. :pray:
